outline:
Engineering Mathematics I
- Ordinary Differential Equations (ODEs)
- Power Series
- Linear Algebra
- Laplace Transforms
- (Matrices)

Pre-request:  Had taken Calculus I & II and Well-established English Skills
schedule:
wk 1        Class Introduction
wk 2-6     Chap. 1  1st Order ODEs, project 01
wk 7        Chap. 2+3  2nd & High Order Linear ODEs
Ch.4 Systems of ODEs, project 02
wk 8        Midterm Exam
wk 9-13   Ch.6  Laplace Transform
wk14-15  Ch.5 Series Solutions of ODEs, Matrix fundamentals
wk16       Final Exam
wk17-18  auxiliary learning
